visual_review.method: Every draft page was inspected individually at readable resolution. The actual final PDF was rendered in full; all changed pages were inspected again, and unchanged pages were matched by SHA256 of decoded RGB pixels. This checks presentation; numerical and reference limitations are stated in the lecture.
